_note: RAMP InterActive tournament sites. Key: words that must all appear in the header competition (lower case). Value: the subdomain of a <sub>.tournamentsgurus.com site, or {"base": the address, "tz": the time zone} for a tournament on its own address. 'EAK Tournament' = Eastern Alliance Kickoff (Worcester/Marlborough MA, early September, U12-U18 AAA). 'Rockies Tournament' = Hockey in the Rockies, Cochrane Minor Hockey (Alberta, mid November, U11-U18 AA). An entry may add "also": general competitions its games are sometimes filed under, used only for games inside "dates": [first day, last day].
